Rubber and Kelp can both be used to make components such as Mechanical Belts, Item Drains, Funnels, and Tunnels.

In the past, there were some creatures that could naturally produce rubber, but they have all gone extinct now. If you want to obtain rubber, you can only do so through artificial synthesis.
Preparation for Crafting

Trains are the essential choice for bulk and long-distance logistics.  
Of course, they can also be used for short distances.  
They can also be used to build convenient contraptions like tunnel bores.  

I believe you’ll need them even if you don’t have long-distance logistics demands — it’s easier and more aesthetically pleasing than laying belts.  

Trains don’t require fuel (though you can use fuel to make them run faster), but that’s not the main point. &aTheir true unique advantage is that they can pass through unloaded chunks!&r  

Set up schedules to make trains run automatically!
Railway Construction

Monorail Train Track is a fun type of train track.
You can use it to build suspended trains!

The Blasting Compressor is a large pressing machine that can quickly process metal blocks.

The Blasting Compressor can compress 9 metal blocks into 81 metal sheets at once, and it also has some unique recipes!

&aView the exact structure in the Ponder, or print it with a Schematicannon. Important: The Schematic does not include the multiblock controller!&r
If you encounter any issues, you can refer to
Page of Engineering

&oTip: If the machine stops working for no reason, check for chunk-loading issues. When click the Structure Block icon at the bottom-left cornor of machine's recipes in JEI, nearby multiblock controllers will check and display structures they required in the world!&r

&e&oTip: If it's working but not outputting items, it might be a Container printing issue. Just break the Container and place it manually!&r&r
Explode! Compress!

Fluid Tanks can store fluids in bulk, a single one can hold &e32&r buckets of fluid!

Buckets cannot directly interact with Fluid Tanks, please use components such as Item Drains to emptying buckets, and use Mechanical Pumps or Faucets to tranfer the fluid.

&eIn the past, a technical defect caused fuel in containers could be ignited by nearby explosions — but thanks to my &oTechnial Improvements&r&e, that's no longer a concern!&r
Fluid Tank

The Wrench can be used to rotate, configure states, quickly dismantle, and edit configurations of components.

Every engineer loves it.

&eThanks to my &oTechnical Improvements&r&e, you can now use the Wrench to dismantle almost anything you'd use in a factory — including Faucets, Drawers, Crafting Tables, and much more!&r
A must-have!
Engineer's Set

Engineer's Goggles can display detailed component information. You can place it in equipment slots.

Every engineer loves it.
A must-have!
Engineer's Set

Electric Gear Sets are essential materials for advanced machine components.

They are used to craft good stuffs such as the Brass Funnel and Nixie Tube.

The Mechanical Crafter automates many standard crafting recipes and is also required to craft certain advanced items during Mechanical Crafting.
Electrical Era!
The Industrial Iron Boiler is used in constructing multiblock structures and is an essential component for advanced production!

Deployers are crafted using an Iron Hand or via Block Crafting.

There are multiple ways to obtain an Iron Hand!

Storage Drawers are exceptionally useful, capable of storing large quantities of a single item type! (2 or 4 for 1x2 and 2x2 drawers, respectively)

Craft various Upgrades and the Drawer Key to expand their functionality — locking, voiding, redstone signaling, icon hiding, and more.

&lStore Items:&r Right-click to store held items; double right-click to store all matching items from your inventory.&r

&lRetrieve Items:&r Left-click a slot to take one item; hold [Shift] and left-click to take a full stack.&r

&e&lAccess GUI:&r&e Hold [Shift] and right-click to open the Drawer's control panel.&r

&c&lCRITICAL WARNING:&r&c Destroying a Drawer destroys ALL items inside! To prevent accidents, you can only break a Drawer while sneaking. (The Steel Impact Drill is an exception.)&r

Seed Oil is an important production material, can be used as temporary fuel, but it's best processed into &eBiodiesel&r, which enables &eSuper-Heated&r in Blaze Burners.

You can build an automated farm to produce it in bulk.

However, due to the world's rules, plants will not grow unless a player is nearby.

If you want to speed up the production, look into recipes involving Yeast and Nitrogen Fertilizer.

&eIn the past, a technical defect caused fuel in containers could be ignited by nearby explosions — but thanks to my &oTechnial Improvements&r&e, that's no longer a concern!&r

And so, industrialization begins!

You may have noticed that Andesite Alloy cannot be crafted in a Crafting Table — from now on, you must leave handcrafting behind and move steadily toward mechanization!

&aYou can obtain your first Andesite Alloy from your spaceship!&r

To automate its production, you &emust&r use a special process — &eBlock Filling&r! &aSee its JEI or Ponder for details!&r

&cRan out of Andesite Alloy? You can find ways to craft a Basin and Basin Foundry Lid without using Andesite Alloy, and purchase a Blaze Burner from the Grocery!&r
The origin
Ready to Speed Up!

Cart Assemblers can be used to attach contraptions to Minecarts. For specific operations, you can check its Ponder.

&eYou can use it to directly take away a large number of blocks (equivalent to cutting and pasting a selection).&r

&aOne thing to mention in advance: Assembled minecarts cannot pass through end portals!&r

You can use it to transport things like Budding Amethysts, Spawners, etc.

You can use the crushing effect it generated when disassembling contraptions to quickly break blocks.

You can use Powered Rails to make the minecart move, or choose to assemble contraption using a Minecart with Furnace and then fuel the minecart.

If you want a minecart contraption that can automatically move forward infinitely, then you need Deployers to place pavement (can also use Mechanical Rollers!), a Deployer for rails, a Deployer for placing blocks to clear liquids on the path, a Mechanical Drill or Roller to clear blocks ahead, and a Mechanical Plough for automatically retrieving rails.

The Huge Crusher is a large crushing machine capable of rapidly processing &cpartial&r crushing recipes — beyond that, &esome crushing recipes can only be executed using the Huge Crusher!&r

&eThe standard processing speed of a Huge Crusher is 4,608,000 units of raw material per hour (for most recipes)&r — additionally, if your raw material input rate is sufficient, all its recipes can operate at double the processing capacity — meaning &eyou can boost efficiency to 9,216,000 units of raw material per hour (for most recipes).&r
If you encounter any issues, you can refer to
Page of Engineering

&aView the exact structure in the Ponder, or print it with a Schematicannon. Important: The Schematic does not include the multiblock controller!&r

&oTip: If the machine stops working for no reason, check for chunk-loading issues. When click the Structure Block icon at the bottom-left cornor of machine's recipes in JEI, nearby multiblock controllers will check and display structures they required in the world!&r

If you really can't figure out how to make the Huge Crusher handle multiple recipes, you might want to check the next page — but please note, it's best if you can come up with the solution yourself — that will greatly help you improve!

Consider a scenario where the crusher needs to process multiple recipes, each requiring 64 items as input. You have two main strategies:
1. Strictly Proportional Belt Mixing: Mix the raw materials on the belt according to the exact proportions. For details, refer to the Ponder on Brass Tunnels!
2. Using Brass Funnels to Fix Input at 64 Items: Regardless of how many types of raw materials are input, a single input of 64 items ensures the recipe remains usable. As long as the input speed is lower than the crusher's processing speed, it will never get stuck!

These are commonly used kinetic blocks, each suitable for different scenarios.  
Connecting large and small cogwheels can double or halve the rotational speed.  
It's important to note that the maximum rotational speed is 256!
The Wheels on the Bus Go Round and Round

It's just a Fluid Tank that has been placed sideways.

It can be surprisingly effective in certain situations.

If you need a fluid Shulker Box, then you can use a &eCanister&r!

Schematics can be used for automatic construction.

Load the schematic in the Schematic Table, then place it into the Schematicannon for automatic printing.

It's important to note that schematics cannot print fluids, cannot print Crafter Slot Covers, often have issues when printing Fluid Tanks, and may occasionally cause filters on machines to disappear.
Therefore, after printing is complete, be sure to carefully inspect the machines.

&eIn the future, you will need to build many multiblock machines — you can use schematics to print their structures. However, please note that the schematics I provide do not include the core or controller of each machine!&r

&eSchematics can also be used for a special type of crafting — Block Crafting.&r
&eYou can view it in its Ponder.&r

&aA small tip is that you can use a deployed schematic as a filter for a Deployer, and then have the Deployer place the structure!&r
Copy yours
Schematic Engineering

Industrial Iron Ingot is a higher-quality alloy.

Using it, you can produce more components using fewer materials.

Initially, you need to obtain it by &eSuper-Heating&r Iron Sheets and Andesite Alloy and then compacting them.

You can use &eBiodiesel&r for Super-Heating.

It's best to set up recipe filtering in advance! (Unless you want to get tons of Iron Plating Blocks)
A Better Alloy

Why not make a Creative Filling Tank using the ritual I invented! It can provide unlimited fuel and water for your portable devices!

&eDue to some special reasons, its recipe is variable — but it shouldn't be a big problem! If your recipe is very difficult, don't worry — as I mentioned earlier: it's not invariable!&r
It's Infinite

Shafts can be used to craft components such as large and small Cogwheels, and can also be directly used to transmit kinetic stress.
They can be encased in a Casing.
Great transmission, love from the shaft

The Encased Fan can perform washing, smoking, blasting, and hauting in bulk, making it the core component of most production lines.

It can increase mineral output, smelt without fuel, bake without fuel, turn Sand into Soul Sand, turn Gravel into Flint, and turn Soul Sand into Nether Wart...

A must-try!
Working component — Encased Fan
Blow, Blow, Thou Winter Wind

Raw Tin can be used for mass-producing Tin Ore!

Check the recipe in JEI!
Or consult the
Page of Metallurgy

&cTin Ore does not generate naturally in the world&r. You need to obtain your first Raw Tin by &acrushing Granite&r, &eand after that, you can produce it through multiplication&r.

Additionally, some mobs in the world retain a strange alloy brought by the Big Rip: &eBronze&r — composed of Tin and Copper — which also has a mysterious connection to Brass.

Now, the world almost no longer allows true bronze to exist. As a result, bronze detached from mobs will become extremely unstable. &eIf you can defeat them, you might be able to obtain tin from them.&r

The Basin Lid can be used for fermentation.

The Ponder content regarding the recipe is somewhat outdated; it's better to check JEI!

&eYou should calculate how many fermentation basins you need based on your requirements, crop yields, and recipe duration, rather than blindly setting a quantity!&r

The Ethanol produced by fermentation can be used to make &eBiodiesel&r — a fuel that provides &eSuper-Heated&r! Note that the ethanol is not suitable for use in Diesel Engines; besides that, it can also be used to produce &eEthylene&r!

Here are some data for you:
Without the &eFortune&r enchantment—
&a1 Wheat plant&r yields on average &e2.71 Wheat Seeds&r + &e1 Wheat&r
&a1 Potato plant&r yields on average &e3.71 Potatoes&r + &e0.02 Poisonous Potatoes&r
&a1 Beetroot plant&r yields on average &e2.71 Beetroot Seeds&r + &e1 Beetroot&r
&a1 Carrot plant&r yields on average &e2.71 Carrots&r

Here is a demonstration of one production plan — don't feel bound by it, but always strive to find more efficient designs!

Since basins can contain up to 16 of each item, you just need to ensure the basin can draw materials from a belt that is always unimpeded and contains all the required ingredients simultaneously!

The plan shown in the image uses Brass Funnels to control ratios, a Brass Tunnel to synchronize and merge inputs, and Drawers for excess material return and destruction to keep the belt unobstructed.
Making... fuels?
Fermentation
The Construction Wand can be used for quick placement and quick destruction.
A Depot is a platform used for placing items to be processed, and it also serves as a surface for item processing.
Look! A Cutting Board!

The Hydropress is a large pressing machine capable of rapidly processing fluid metals and metal blocks with lower strength.

&eThe Hydropress can process 1B, 3B, 6B, or 9B of fluid at a time, but with some loss.&r

&eYou need to control the Hydropress's operation yourself using a redstone system — check Ponder for details!&r

&aView the exact structure in the Ponder, or print it with a Schematicannon. Important: The schematic does not include the multiblock controller!&r
If you encounter any issues, you can refer to
Page of Engineering

&oTip: If the machine stops working for no reason, check for chunk-loading issues. When click the Structure Block icon at the bottom-left cornor of machine's recipes in JEI, nearby multiblock controllers will check and display structures they required in the world!&r

Essentially, you don't need to check whether the Hydropress's input is already full — you just need to keep it running!

The Hydropress can be used to efficiently handle situations with multiple types of metal fluids mixed together — like an Alloy Furnace working with multiple recipes!
The Way of Water

Automatically commit!
Automate the Tasks

Using the Alloy Furnace, you can quickly produce large quantities of alloys such as Industrial Iron and Brass. Additionally, during the smelting process, some strange alloys may be produced — don't throw them away as waste!
Accept this materials pack that can be crafted by
Blueprint Construction Station
! It contains every blocks to build a Alloy Furnace's structure!

If you really can't figure out how to make the Alloy Furnace handle multiple recipes, you might want to check the next page — but please note, it's best if you can come up with the solution yourself — that will greatly help you improve!

Consider a scenario where the alloy furnace needs to process crushed raw iron and crushed raw copper simultaneously, first we address the input issue.

It can be noted that the alloy furnace processes 81 crushed raw iron and 54 crushed raw copper per batch, with a greatest common divisor of 27.

We can consider using a brass funnel for 27-item input. Regardless of the order in which we input iron and copper, as long as the furnace inventory does not get blocked within three inputs, the alloy furnace will always have a recipe it can process (3*27=81).

Copper only requires 54 to process one recipe, meaning that as long as copper can be input, it will definitely be processed within three inputs — and processing copper will create input space for iron.

If the input speed exceeds the alloy furnace's processing speed, the furnace will still get blocked — but through simple calculations, it can be determined that the brass funnel inputs 27 items every 9gt, which is far from reaching the alloy furnace's processing speed for the corresponding recipe. Therefore, inputting in this way will never cause the alloy furnace to get blocked.

So, how do we solve the fluid extraction problem? One solution is to use Hose Pulleys with Smart Fluid Pipes! — A better solution is to use a Hydropress to handle the output fluid!

Logistics is always a headache

The Emergency Industrial Platform can be used to quickly build the foundation of an industrial area! And its construction cost is very cheap!

After my &oTechnical Improvements&r, it can now be placed in four directions!

&aAfter being placed, it will display its working range with particles.&r

Perhaps there are other uses?
Emergency Industrial Platform

The Stressometer can view the total stress capacity and remaining stress capacity in the stress network.
The Speedometer can view the rotational speed.
Their values can be read by the Display Link.
In this quest line, you will see some available methods of stress generation.
What Is, and What Remains?

The Lathe can better process metal materials
It has unique automation methods

Fan Catalyst helps you better utilize the Encased Fan.
It won't cause unintended interactions with the environment.

You can mass-produce Wool in a similar way to Wood Chips!

Wool can be used to make &aFilters&r and &eSeats&r! &6And Seats can be used to seal some powerful monsters — such as dragons in the Overworld!&r

Crimsite can be used for mass-producing Iron Ore!

The Empty Blaze Burner can be lit with &eRegular Fire&r or &bSoul Fire&r to make the Encased Fan function.

The Rolling Mill is an important machine in metal processing!
It is used to produce metal rods and wires.

Mechanical Pistons can push up to 2048 blocks glued together at once!

However, you are mainly using it to make Deployers now.
Without the Place to Stand, and I Also Move the Earth

Using Andesite Alloy on Chip Wood Blocks, Logs, and Stripped Logs creates an Andesite Casing.

You need it to craft a Mechanical Core.
Basic mechanism

Compacting Drawers can not only store items but also handle some simple recipes, transforming items into their compressed forms.

You can freely choose to store/take items in any of these states — for instance, you can simultaneously take out blocks, ingots, and nuggets.

&eProperly utilizing Filters and Compacting Drawers can greatly simplify your production lines!&r
Sand Papers can used to polish Rose Quartzs.

The Spout can fill fluids into items on a Depot or Mechanical Belt.

In addition, I have invented a series of &eBlock Filling&r recipes for you to use!

These include filling to transform blocks into items, filling to transform blocks into other blocks, filling to yield items, filling to generate blocks, filling to catalyze fungal growth, and other types!

You can view general Spout recipes in &aJEI&r, or check out &eBlock Filling&r recipes in &aPonder&r!

You can see an example of Block Filling in the Ponder for &eAndesite Alloy&r!
Filling the Fluids!

The Hose Pulley is a crucial component — it can make fluids infinite and conveniently extract fluids.

When the fluid pool the Hose Pulley extracts from contains 512 cubic meters or more of certain fluids, it can extract them infinitely.

Build a 512-cubic-meter infinite lava pool to obtain unlimited fuel!

&eAlternatively, both the underground of the Overworld and the Nether have many large lava pools or even lava seas!&r

(Recommended size: 8*8*8)
Refer to
Slimeli_'s Music Score
to check the list of fluids that can be infinitely extracted! (Click the line to jump)
&aBy the way, thanks to my &oTechnical Improvements&r&a, Mechanical Pumps now have a maximum lift of 24 blocks in either direction!&r
Bottomless pit
Infinite Fluid Sources!
Multi-slot Fluid Drawers can be used to conveniently separate fluid products!

The Basin can be used for automatic packing, mixing, and brewing,  
as well as for melting metals and microbial fermentation.
Not a cauldron
Press, Mix, Boil

Super Glue is used to create larger Contraptions and makes Linear Chassis no longer a necessity.

However, I still recommend using Linear Chassis more often, as it is indeed more convenient.
The Art of Gluing

Copper is the primary material for the fluid system, and is also used to make Brass.  

You have some on your spaceship, and you can use them to startup!
Basic material — Copper
All the Copper

The first movement is the foundation of Cogwheels, Steam, and Computer Science.

The power of machinery will ensure your livelihood.

&cNote that many recipes may differ from what you are familiar with, so please carefully review the quest descriptions, Ponder, and JEI!&r

&cI recommend you to completely abandon all past detailed experience!&r

&eThis current measure mostly covers some of the earliest guidance and a brief introduction to most of the first movement!&r

&eIf you need better storage, you can check the "Beyond Dimensions" measure!&r

&eIf you need guidance on planning, you can check the "Factory Network" measure!&r

By the end of this movement, I hope you will build a preliminary industrial area.
Welcome to Create!
Let's get started

Sturdy Sheets are a vital material for railway engineering.

Train Casings made from them are used to make Train Stations, create Bogies and other stuffs.

Train Schedules made from them are used to schedule trains.

They are also used in Enchanting Guides, Cooking Guides and various advanced mechanical equipments.

You have four main methods to obtain Obsidian:
&eMixing Cryogen with Lava.&r
&eFilling Obsidian Powder (TN: deprecated) with Water and Lava.&r
&eObsidian produced by the contact of Cryogen and Lava&r
&eObsidian produced by the contact of Water and a Lava source&r
Age of Trains!

Steam Engines are a primary source of rotational power in the early game (Water Wheels and Windmills in very-early game).

Faucets can conveniently supply water to boilers. Passive heat sources like Magma Blocks or Campfires can be used to offer heats. Check the Ponder for Faucets and Steam Engines for details.

This setup creates a boiler that runs without active fueling. But what happens if we &ldo&r supply fuel?

Straws allow the Blaze Burner to accept fluid fuels for burning!

&eFaucet output rate is 250 mB/s.&r
Packed with power
Lvl 0 Steam Boiler

Fluid Drawers function like regular Drawers, but they store fluids instead of items.

They can also interact with a Drawer Controller!

Unlike regular Drawers, Fluid Drawers cannot be equipped with Remote Upgrades.
Piston Extension Poles are used in Mechanical Pistons and are needed when craft Deployers via Block Crafting.
Where's My Head?

Just a simple grappling hook!

But may bring unexpected mobility in low-gravity environments!

It needs fuel and water to work — try Creative Filling Tank!
Most advanced components related to signals require Circuit Boards to craft.

&eA &aTunnel Bore&r &ecan satisfy most of your rare mineral needs, while a &r&aRoad Paver&r &ecan quickly lay out industrial zones.&r You can also build an Emergency Industrial Platform!

&eBeyond the parts mentioned, you'll also need a sufficiently large Item Vault (or many chests) to store your harvest, some Portable Storage Interfaces for logistics, and a &aSeat&r — so you can ride along with your machine.&r

Additionally, you can research some advanced functionalities:

&aAutomatically place torches at regular intervals.&r (Hint: A Mechanical Saw can chop down an entire tree at once, &eeven if it's horizontal&r.)

&aAutomatically clear out fluids.&r (Hint: Deployers can place blocks to displace fluids.)

&aRailless Minecarts.&r (Hint: A Mechanical Plough can launch entities.)

&aAuto-return or auto-pause functions.&r (Hint: Portable Storage Interfaces, Redstone Contacts.)

&aAnti-entity-blocking.&r (&eEntities like falling gravel can prevent Deployers from placing blocks.&r Hint: Mechanical Plough.)

Crushing Wheels crush minerals and other materials.

&eThey play an important role in mass-producing mineral products and Wood Chips.&r
&eWith these, you can make (almost) anything from cobblestone!&r

Your spaceship had two peculiar structures that this world has transformed into Crushing Wheels. You can use them for the moment, but you can't rely solely on those.

&aYou can build more using Block Crafting — check its JEI or Ponder!&r
Mass-produce those minerals!
Craftable via Block Crafting!
A Pair of Heavy Guys

Contraptions are an essential part of Create — you'll &o&ldefinitely&r want to try them!

To build useful moving contraptions, Slimeballs are a must!

Slimeballs can be crafted from Lime Dye and Dough, centrifuged from Magma Cream, synthesized from Polymer... or obtained from a specific mob — the Slime. &eHowever, Slimes do not exist on most planets. On Earth, they are only found in certain ancient ruins.&r

&aSwamps and underground in specific chunks...? What are you talking about? Is that knowledge from your homeworld? Do Slimes live there too?&r
No! That's Not a Snot!
The Industrial Iron Boiler is used in constructing multiblock structures and is an essential component for advanced production!

Water Wheels are the best early-game source of rotational power! (Though you might have other options on your spaceship?)

If you get a Water Wheel spinning first and then connect it to a Large Water Wheel, the larger one will spin faster!

Early sources of rotational power
Spin the Mill!
The Spring Coiling Machine is used to craft important machines.

Ochrum can be used to mass-produce Gold ore!

Check the recipe in JEI!

Page of Metallurgy

Metal sheets are essential materials in Create.

Golden Sheets are used for important items like the Wrench and Engineer's Goggles.

&eThe Mechanical Press can also mass-produce resources like Crimsite and Asurine.&r (TN: Asurine is deleted since Beta 0.7.1)

Craft at least one Mechanical Press to start producing metal sheets!
Pressing sheets
Feel the Momentum

The Bearing is a vital component, extensively used across industrial components!

What? How do you fill the Spout without a Mechanical Pump? &eTake a look at the Faucet!&r

&cNote: The Faucet may cause minor fluid loss in certain situations.&r (TN: No loss since Beta 0.7.1)

&aBy the way, thanks to my &oTechnical Improvements&r&a, Mechanical Pumps now have a maximum lift of 24 blocks in either direction!&r

Before you begin mass production, it's best to have already established reliable lines for &emetal production&r, &eSeed Oil&r, and &eAndesite Alloy&r.

I'll provide a sample production layout as a starting point — don't feel bound by it, but always strive to find more efficient designs!

As an alternative, you can use &eChip Wood Blocks&r for these recipes.
Basic material — Wood

Variation - Beyond Dimensions

Gold is a highly useful ore, essential for crafting several important alloys.

You can choose to mine some underground or in the Nether, search for it in ruins, or wait until you have mass-produced Iron and obtaining it from Tuff!

Shiny!

&aWhat? Why Brass is made from Copper and Gold, not Copper and Zinc? In your homeworld, should it be Copper and Zinc? Fascinating... perhaps this hints at a deeper unity across realities...&r

&eAh, I digress. The truth is, here too, Brass was once made from Copper and Zinc — before the Big Rip. That event reshaped many things: it altered the very recipe of Brass and created a mysterious link between Brass and Bronze. You'll come to understand this in time.&r
The Brass Age!

The Portable Drill has exceptional mining efficiency and &ethe mining level of Netherite&r.

When enchanted, it can mine a 3*3 area in a single operation!

It serves as a compact grinding alternative and is essential for certain specific recipes!

&aLow Speed: 1-16 RPM&r
&bMedium Speed: 17-64 RPM&r
&cHigh Speed: 65-256 RPM&r

Blaze Spawners can be found within the larger Nether structures known as fortresses.

&eBut I would recommend to purchase it directly from the Grocery instead!&r

You can perform the &eCarry On&r ritual to pick up and move Spawners!

&e[Shift]+Right-click&r a Spawner while empty-handed to carry it.

&aPress [U] while hovering over a Blaze Burner in your inventory to see which fluid fuel it accepts!&r

&eAccept this Eternal Blaze Burner. It will burn for a duration beyond imagination — effectively forever. In the distant future, you'll be able to craft these using Information Elements, but that time has not yet come.&r

&6WARNING: If you break the burner or insert a Straw into it, it will lose its eternal property. To prevent this, always transport it using a moving contraption!&r

Have a Deployer use a Large Cogwheel on an Andesite Casing!

A Drawer Controller links to Drawers within a 50-block cubic radius centered on itself.

This device enables chunk forceloading, allowing machines to run continuously regardless of player proximity.

Force-Load!
Every architect loves it!

If you find yourself in need of Charcoal... (though you probably won't at this stage?)

&eI recommend smelting Chip Wood Blocks to produce it!&r

A Drawer with a Void Upgrade will destroy any items that exceed its capacity.

This is ideal for getting rid of unwanted surplus or waste materials.

Crafting Blueprints allow for convenient crafting!
Once configured the recipe, simply right-click to craft once.
Hold [Shift] while right-clicking to craft the maximum amount!
Use a Mechanical Mixer to combine Water with Lava, producing large quantities of Cobblestone quickly!
Working component — Mechanical Mixer

Blaze Mycoplasma primarily inhabits the Nether, where it consumes local fuels to regulate the dimension's temperature.

It can be used to optimize certain recipes or to cultivate another microorganism.

&eCheck the Empty Map icon in the bottom-left corner of the recipe in JEI to see which biomes the recipe requires.&r

The Metal Protozoa is a microorganism capable of transmuting basic metals into one another.

&eIt can be found in Netherite Scrap — use Shadow Steel to produces Netherite!&r

Yeast thrives in environments rich in plant fibers.

As one of the most powerful fungi in the Overworld, Yeast creates conditions that kills many microbes: it rapidly consumes oxygen to form anaerobic environments and produces toxic Ethanol. Additionally, it can survive in highly saline environment.

You can harness it to efficiently produce Sugar, Seed Oil, and Ethanol.

&eCheck the Empty Map icon in the bottom-left corner of the recipe in JEI to see which biomes the recipe requires.&r

Useless Bacteria is a collective term for microorganisms whose specific uses have not yet been discovered (or which specific microbe is effective remains unidentified).

While they have no special application, like other microorganisms, they can still be processed into Biomass.

&eCheck the Empty Map icon in the bottom-left corner of the recipe in JEI to see which biomes the recipe requires.&r

Sculk is a photophobic, saprophytic microorganism that thrives on the death of creatures.

The Sculk Catalyst represents the highly reproductive part of a Sculk colony. It generates various Sculk-derived products and possesses an ability to produce Experience.

&eCheck the Empty Map icon in the bottom-left corner of the recipe in JEI to see which biomes the recipe requires.&r

While crafting Super Glue, you likely discovered the importance of Slimes.

Now, the Mycetozoan — a Slime symbiont — elevates that importance to an unreachable level!

Mycetozoa can be used to produce Slime fluid, Slime Colloid, and Slime Resin, making them vital neutralizers and binders for industrial production.

&eCheck the Empty Map icon in the bottom-left corner of the recipe in JEI to see which biomes the recipe requires.&r

The Resonant Protozoa is a microorganism commonly found around planet orbit, feeding on cosmic radiation.

It possesses remarkable abilities: generating lasers, transforming radiation, storing data, and manipulating space. These make it crucial for many advanced recipes, and the foundational element of your coming orbital industry!

&eCheck the Empty Map icon in the bottom-left corner of the recipe in JEI to see which biomes the recipe requires.&r

Graphene is a carbon material with excellent properties.
You will need a lot of it for aerospace engineering.
You can use the Blue Blaze Chlamydia to load the Empty Brass Chunk Loader!

Let's begin with the Culture Bin.

The Brass Culture Bin is the essential device for obtaining most microorganisms.

&aA Brass Culture Bin automatically outputs products to containers on all six sides — and a Mechanical Belt counts as a container too!&r

&eIt checks for valid outputs in this order: down, up, north, south, west, east.&r

&eChutes without a set filter will not function properly near a Brass Culture Bin. Internally, for auto-output, 'no filter' is treated as 'air only'!&r

&aGenerally, you should use the appropriate Culture Plate in the correct biome to obtain a specific microbe. For most microbes, once you acquire a single sample, you can cultivate it in bulk.&r

&eCheck the Empty Map icon in the bottom-left corner of the recipe in JEI to see which biomes the recipe requires.&r
&eSee the Ponder to learn how to perform Exact Belt Mixing!&r

A key challenge with the Brass Culture Bin is recirculating the microbe itself.

You can take full advantage of its auto-output function to achieve this.

Use an Inventory Access Port to allow the Culture Bin to output back into itself.
Alternatively, you can export all products, separate, and return the microbes back alone.
The Hotbed

You can now craft Plastic Steel (TN: the material is still named 'Steel' right now, from Create: Love and War), an excellent material for advanced tools.

With it, you can craft the Steel Impact Drill and Steel Power Sword — powerful equipment that will serve you well. &eThe Impact Drill can even break Bedrock!&r

Additionally, you are now able to craft the Expert Gunsmithing Bench.
Engineer's Kit

&eThe Huge Electrolytic Cell is a multiblock machine!&r You must build the correct structure around its controller to activate it!

&6WARNING: If power runs out during a run, you will lose ALL input materials!&r

It performs electrolysis recipes much faster and can process unique recipes unavailable to smaller machines.
See its Ponder for detailed usage.

&eThe Carbon Electrode has a 5%% chance to be consumed each time before cathode OR anode products are discharged. Note: cathode and anode consumption are independent events!&r

Electrolysis of Water does not consume the electrode, which is a good news to you.

&aView the exact structure in the Ponder, or print it with a Schematicannon. Important: The Schematic does not include the multiblock controller!&r

&oTip: If the machine stops working for no reason, check for chunk-loading issues. Reloading the world usually solves 99%% of such problems.&r
A Better Electrolyzer!

&aBy now, I believe you have laid the foundations of chemical industry and electrical infrastructure.&r

Before turning our gaze to the stars, let us first learn to harness the power of the microorganisms that inhabit this world.

These minute life forms will enable us to accomplish the grandest of projects.

&eIn this measure, you will journey far and wide to discover the habitats of various microbes and learn how to utilize them to make your production more advanced and efficient.&r
A Focus on the Micro

Although it may sound strange — Cheese is an essential component in Desh production.

You can obtain Milk on the Moon using one of these three methods:

&e1. Breed Cows on the lunar surface.&r
&e2. Capture a baby Cow in a &r&aCage&r&e; a caged baby Cow can be milked (What? Inhumane!).&r

3. Use a Milk Information Element to catalyze Milk production.

Carborundum is a highly heat-resistant ceramic material.
Beyond its use in aerospace engineering, it also serves as an effective abrasive for grinding.
You can combine a Spawner with Spawn Eggs to mass-produce specific mobs.
Fiber Fabric is a specially-infused, non-woven carbon fiber material that provides excellent sealing and thermal insulation, making it the core material for Space Suits.

When Metal Protozoa produce ores, they generate vast quantities of Limestone as a byproduct. This may explain why the Overworld remains predominantly land, despite being so rich in water.

But what can be done with all that Limestone?

The Chromatic Protozoa is a microorganism from the End, a living symbol of that dimension's once-prosperous past.

During the Big Rip, nearly all of the End's water was drained into the Overworld, making survival difficult for the protozoa's ancestors. Over millennia of evolution, the Chromatic Protozoa — which requires almost no moisture — emerged and replaced them.

It can be used to transmute various dyes and to produce Chromatic Waste.

&eCheck the Empty Map icon in the bottom-left corner of the recipe in JEI to see which biomes the recipe requires.&r

Using the Chromatic Waste you've produced, you can now create a new material — Chromatic Compound.

While Chromatic Compound isn't useful on its own, it's a key intermediate that can be transformed into high-quality materials — such as Refined Radiance.

Blue Blaze Chlamydia is the ancestral form of Blaze Mycoplasma. They once thrived on the abundant high-energy fuel released by the Big Rip, but gradually faded from the Nether as those fuels were depleted.

They can be used to create an environment even hotter than Super-Heated, useful to many important recipes such as Overheated Steam, Carborundum, and Graphene Coils.

Moreover, they are essential for entering the space age — they are used to produce Steel.

If you require large quantities of them, consider reproducing them using Blaze Cakes.

&eCheck the Empty Map icon in the bottom-left corner of the recipe in JEI to see which biomes the recipe requires.&r

Cheese Moonalgae is an alga that inhabits exclusively the Moon.

It can convert Milk into Cheese and is also used in the production of Desh.

&eCheck the Empty Map icon in the bottom-left corner of the recipe in JEI to see which biomes the recipe requires.&r

Blaze Wart is a novel species that emerged from genetic hybridization between Blaze Mycoplasma and Nether Wart.

Its metabolites can transform Water into Awkward Potions, and are capable of reprogramming certain biological cells, reverting them to a stem cell state.

Peat Protozoa inhabit Swamps, Mushroom Fields, and Jungle biomes.

&eIt has the ability to convert Charcoal into Coal, playing a decisive role in coal production!&r

&eCheck the Empty Map icon in the bottom-left corner of the recipe in JEI to see which biomes the recipe requires.&r

Mastering cache usage is a fundamental skill in production line design. It enables you to:
- Merge scattered items into stacks.
- Smooth out and average the transportation speed of items.
- Remove unwanted rubbish that accidentally mixed in (e.g., a zombie that died on the belt or something else).
- Handle surplus items.
...
Based on your needs, you can implement caches using various containers like Barrels or Drawers. Make full use of the output limit and filter functions of Brass Funnels. To prevent overaccumulation in caches, set filters on the output and fill most of the cache's inventory slots with junk items.
The Art of Caching

Besides right-clicking a Blaze,

you can also right-click a Blaze Spawner with an Empty Blaze Burner to fill it!

After the Big Rip, the very foundations of the world were shaken, giving rise to the bizarre and chaotic landscape you see now.

&aTo maintain normal life and production in this distorted reality, you must understand the concepts of &r&eWorld Instability&r&a and &r&ePerceptual Continuity&r, and learn how to manage them.

Think of the world as a vast, running program. Every entity, machine, container, and their interactions add load to the program — this is what we call &eWorld Instability&r. &aAs World Instability rises, all mobs become sluggish, machines operate erratically, and every interaction suffers severe latency...&r

They also affect &ePerceptual Continuity&r. Unlike World Instability, this effect is localized and influences only a creature's perception of the world. &aWhen Perceptual Continuity drops in an area, your view of the world becomes fragmented, making it difficult to perceive smoothly.&r

I have prepared two rituals to help you measure and influence them.

The first is &eF3&r (which, of course, has other uses). Pressing F3 displays two key metrics in the top-left corner: &amspt&r (milliseconds per tick) and &aFPS&r (frames per second). Here, mspt represents &eWorld Instability&r, and FPS represents &ePerceptual Continuity&r.

&6For FPS, higher is obviously better.&r However, once it reaches a certain threshold, further increases have little noticeable effect. To improve FPS, &ereduce the scale and visual complexity within your field of view — for example, avoid looking at distant chunks, or minimize the number of complex blocks and mobs on-screen.&r

&6For mspt, lower is better, though it can never reach zero. &rDon't be overly anxious about the number — the world has a "rated load" of 50 mspt. &aAs long as mspt stays below 50, there will be no substantive impact on the world. &r&eTo lower mspt, reduce the number of active machines and entities, optimize machine layouts, and replace high-load machines with more efficient alternatives.&r

The second is Observable. &eI have not set an activation key for you, you must configure it yourself. &rObservable can scan all blocks and entities in the world over a 30-second period, calculate their load contribution, and display the results visually (this takes a moment). Use it to identify which objects are placing the heaviest load on the world, and then try to reduce them. (Note: 1 mspt = 1000 μspt)

Some known high-load machines include: &ehighly complex pipe networks (with many connected pipes), Mechanical Arms, Desh Fluid Pipes, Ostrum Fluid Pipes, Steel Cables, and Desh Cables.&r

Some known high-load entities include: &epiles of Item Entities (Drops)&r, Bees, Allays, Villagers, and large moving Contraptions.

Some known high-load behaviors include: &eusing Smart Fluid Pipes to extract fluids from a Drawer network.&r
World Instability and Perceptual Continuity

A successful, efficient factory requires a proper plan and design!

&aBroadly speaking, production line planning falls into two main paradigms: the &eBlack-Box Factory&a and the &eBus-Based Factory&r.

&aA &eBlack-Box Factory&a is one where, for a given production line, there is &elittle to no external input&a. All manufacturing steps are completed internally, and it &eonly outputs the final product and byproducts&a to the outside.&r
This design is ideal for consolidating production lines that are tightly interlinked, or where intermediate products have little demand and only the final product is required!

&aA &eBus-Based Factory&a refers to a production line that meets one of the following two criteria:&r
&a- Almost all raw materials are input from a &ecentral bus&a.&r
&a- Almost all products are output to a &ecentral bus&a for further distribution.&r
This design suits products that are highly demanded by many lines, or have complex production processes! It segments production stages, significantly reducing our design complexity! &eIt is basically a more efficient way to "add flour if it's too wet, add water if it's too dry"&r (Chinese idiom).

&aRegarding the &ebus&a, it refers to this model: connect several factories, which producing or needing certain common products, to a central logistics bus. Downstream factories needing the product only take it from the bus, while upstream factories producing the product only replenish it to the bus.&r
This way, you only need to keep the bus sufficiently stocked, without detailed calculations! For high-demand or frequently needed products, set at least one logistics Bus for each!

&aYou can build your logistics bus using Mechanical Belt, Drawer networks, train networks, Rocket/Space Elevator logistics hubs, and other methods.&r
Black Box vs. Bus

The Synchronize Inputs mode can also ensure items are successfully transferred onto the belt. However, note that it does not guarantee the input order of items!
